title: SessionStorage Function-call via document.write
description: DOM-based XSS where a value read from sessionStorage is passed as an argument into a rendering function that feeds it directly into document.write().
objectives: Trace how the 'content' key flows from sessionStorage.getItem() through renderPage(...) into document.write().
Confirm that, unlike innerHTML, document.write() executes injected <script> tags directly.
Note that this value only persists for the current tab's session, unlike the localStorage equivalent of this case.
hints: renderPage(value) wraps value in a <div> and hands it to document.write() — a plain <script>alert(1)</script> payload runs here.
Reset the state with sessionStorage.removeItem('content') or sessionStorage.clear().
body:
SessionStorage -> document.write() (function-call context)

Set sessionStorage.content; it is passed through renderPage() before reaching document.write().
